questions.question: Identify the types of unordered or bulleted lists in HTML
questions.solution_html:
• Identify the types of unordered or bulleted lists in HTML /
  • The common types of unordered or bulleted lists include:
  • • Disc: This is the default style, represented by a filled circle.
  • • Circle: This style uses an empty circle as the bullet marker.
  • • Square: This style displays a filled square as the bullet marker.
  • • None: This option removes the bullet marker entirely, resulting in a list without any visual
  • markers.
  • Any three types- (1 Mark)
